title: ASTM C 635, Section 4.
officialText:
5. Add section 4.5 as follows:
4.5 Splines shall not be considered as providing nor shall be used for providing structural support for the ceiling material.
SECTION BC R103
MODIFICATIONS TO ASTM C 636 – STANDARD
PRACTICE FOR INSTALLATION OF METAL CEILING
SUSPENSION SYSTEMS FOR ACOUSTICAL TILE
AND LAY-IN PANELS
